mapper.insert: insert into pay_order( user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, market_type, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount, create_time, update_time) values( #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{marketType}, #{marketDeductionAmount}, #{payAmount}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select product_id, product_code, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, market_type, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} and product_code = #{productCode} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, status = #{status}, market_type = #{marketType}, market_deduction_amount = #{marketDeductionAmount}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT')
update pay_order set status = #{status}, pay_time = ifnull(#{payTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, now()), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT')
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT')
mapper.select: SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT user_id, order_id, status, market_type, pay_amount, pay_time, settlement_notified FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_SUCCESS' AND market_type = 1 AND settlement_notified = 0 AND NOW() >= update_time + INTERVAL 2 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: update pay_order set settlement_notified = 1, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and settlement_notified = 0
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, order_id, status, market_type, pay_amount, pay_time FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_REFUND' AND NOW() >= update_time + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: update pay_order set status = 'DEAL_DONE', update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('PAY_SUCCESS', 'MARKET')
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status != 'CLOSE'
update pay_order set status = 'WAIT_REFUND', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('PAY_SUCCESS', 'MARKET', 'DEAL_DONE')
